snippet.title: Erulean Angel: Fantasy Commander - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Get another look at Erulean Angel: Fantasy Commander in this latest trailer for the upcoming autobattler strategy RPG. Erulean Angel: Fantasy Commander will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.

Set out on a grand adventure of exploration, strategy, and mystery in Erulean Angel: Fantasy Commander. Immerse yourself in a handmade world as you craft armies to outwit your opponents in fully simulated autobattler combat.
